messages:
Avery Chen (CEO): Quick weekly — thanks for the push this sprint. High-level asks for the week:
• SLA: keep hosted p95 <= 220ms. No exceptions for paid tiers.
• Private: target GA checklist complete by EOD Friday (security signoff + install docs).
• Cost: aim for ~12% unit cost reduction on chat traffic via batching/quant recommendations.
• Observability: add one dashboard tile per product route for token_cost_per_1k and p95.
Link to short deck: https://redwood.example.com/ops/weekly-5345 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Jordan Lee (VP Eng): noted. Will spin up an extra SRE sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to prioritize hot fixes and batching work.

Priya Reddy (VP Product): FYI — product needs the privacy review signoff before we flip Private GA. Pinged Security for review; expecting response by Thu noon.

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): I can run smoke tests on the canary tonight after the deploy. Will post logs here.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for release/2026-03-23 (canary-1) — rolling to 3 hosts.

Tom Brewer (Platform PM): For the cost target, ops-optimize team proposed two quick wins: auto-prefix cache for chat + reduce default max_tokens from 2048 -> 1536 in medium workload routes. Both are low-risk.

Leah Kim (Finance): Heads-up: Q2 budget check — if we hit the 12% reduction goal we can free up ~$120k/mo. Need confirmation from Eng on feasibility by Friday.

Jordan Lee (VP Eng): quick note — if canary looks good we still keep a canary window of 2 hours before gradual rollout. Marta, throw the smoke command when ready:
```
./infra/run_smoke.sh --env=canary-1 --suite=core-paths
```

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): running now. posting tail of logs in 10m.

Avery Chen (CEO): Thanks all. Two tactical asks:
1) Product + Security — update private GA checklist doc with signoff names.
2) Eng + Finance — confirm cost plan and owners for the 12% workstream.

Avery Chen (CEO): Also short people note — we will pause non-customer-facing hiring next sprint to focus budget on infra and reliability. More details in the deck. :memo:

Priya Reddy (VP Product): understoood. I'll update the checklist and add Security reviewer slot.

Jordan Lee (VP Eng): on the 12% plan — I'll own batching and Tom will track quantization experiments.

Leah Kim (Finance): copying the budget team. We'll mark this as an accelerator in the Q2 plan if engineering confirms by EOW.

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): smoke looks clean so far — no 5xx, p95 on canary at ~180ms for simulated load. Posting snippet:
```
[INFO] 200 OK - p95=180ms - 0.3% error
```

Avery Chen (CEO): Nice. If prod p95 holds under rollout, green to proceed with staged rollout tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Tom Brewer (Platform PM): launching a ticket to Console team to add the metric tile; ETA Wed EOD.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment complete — canary-1 healthy.

Avery Chen (CEO): Closing note — thanks to everyone for rapid alignment. Small, measurable wins on cost + reliability are our focus for the next 2 sprints. Keep the weekly updates tight; flag blockers early.

Jordan Lee (VP Eng): +1.

Priya Reddy (VP Product): :white_check_mark:

Marta Gomez (Eng-SRE): will follow up with full logs and a short post-canary note by EOD.
